label: Single issued-content consequence
definition: Derived n q means there exists ONE predicate p with n.issued p and, for every outcome a, p a implies q a. Norms.issued is the existing primitive extensional issuance input; outcomes and predicates are supplied. No conjunction of different issued predicates is formed. Empty issuance derives nothing, impossible issued content derives everything. This is neither issuance of q, adequate compliance, practical possibility nor legitimate normative authority.
